events.verdict: Matthews (DAL) and Harden (HOU) briefly engage off-ball, but the contact is marginal.
Brunson (DAL) is not in a legal guarding position when contact occurs with Paul's (HOU) arm. The contact occurs prior to Paul's upward shooting motion.
Gordon (HOU) briefly grasps Matthews (DAL) but the contact is marginal.
Tucker (HOU) makes marginal contact with Doncic (DAL) going over the legal pick.
Doncic (DAL) initiates contact with Tucker (HOU) but contact is marginal on his driving shot attempt.
Jordan (DAL) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Brunson (DAL) steps towards Harden (HOU) as Harden releases the shot and slightly extends his leg. The contact is marginal and does not take away his landing area.
Tucker (HOU) and Doncic (DAL) engage off-ball but disengage without affecting each other's freedom of movement.
Harden (HOU) gathers the ball and takes two steps during his drive and shot attempt.

LATR shows Brunson (DAL) moves toward Harden (HOU) and then along his path before he has gathered the ball. The angle also shows that when Harden raises his arm to start the upward motion, Brunson pulls back and allows him to complete his shooting motion.
Jordan (DAL) is in a legal screening position in Tucker's (HOU) path when contact occurs and he absorbs contact.
Paul (HOU) makes marginal contact with Brunson's (DAL) body that does not affect his shot attempt near the rim.
Harden (HOU) moves laterally into Matthews's (DAL) path in transition and affects his SQBR.
Jordan (DAL) and Capela (HOU) make incidental contact with one another during rebounding.
Tucker (HOU) sets the pick in Matthews's (DAL) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Matthews (DAL) cleanly dislodges the ball from Harden (HOU).
Barnes (DAL) holds Gordon (HOU) during the inbound and affects his SQBR.
Hilario (HOU) is firming up in a screening position in Barnes's (DAL) path when contact occurs and he absorbs contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Gordon (HOU) steps out of bounds before releasing his jump shot attempt.
Finney-Smith (DAL) legally contests Gordon's (HOU) jump shot.
